mosaic.description: Fused mosaic volume stitched from 19 helical half-acquisition tiles (T0 center + T1 ring of 6 + T2 ring of 12). All tiles share identical acquisition parameters (energy, pixel size, z-range, detector, processing). Only the horizontal stage positions (motors.sx, motors.sy) and the per-tile timestamp/comment differ.
